A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''assassin''' served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anathemos]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Means of Persuasion" />

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] known as [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] delivered a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] to Lord [[Anathemos]] in exchange for the [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].

Under Kallig's command, the assassins were ordered to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Ashara Zavros]]. However, the plan was that Kallig only wanted Ashara to live, and the assassins would die. The trio were angry to learn that Kallig deceived them when they confronted the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]]. Kallig turned against them, and killed about two assassins, leaving the remaining assassin. The injured assassin relented and begged Ashara to spare him. Kallig sensed that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] faded away from him, and taunted Ashara in order to strike him down with no mercy. The assassin begged her to not listen to Kallig, but Ashara apologized and killed him.<ref name="Means of Persuasion" />
